The user says: "I want to confirm if the seamless pants are not available in all three?" They likely refer to availability across three stores or locations. We need to interpret what they mean. They might want to check availability of seamless pants across three stores. We have no store data. We can ask clarifying question: which stores? Or we can respond with a generic answer: "We don't have real-time inventory." But maybe we should ask them to specify store names.
